title: Stochastic Averaging and Statistical Inference of Glycolytic Pathway
summary: Many biological processes exhibit oscillatory behavior. Among these, glycolytic oscillations have been extensively studied due to their well-characterized biochemical reaction networks. However, the complexity of these networks necessitates low-dimensional ordinary differential equation (ODE) models to identify core mechanisms and perform stability analysis.
